title: CropCard Companion Plugin
description: Pairwise companion + multi-crop interplanting system (e.g., Three Sisters). Drives the companion advisor + the group-planning engine. Mirrors apps/web/src/lib/plugins/schemas.ts (companionPluginSchema) — the Zod schema is the runtime source of truth; this file is documentation for plugin authors.

goodWith.description: Crop pluginIds that pair well with each other when interplanted on the same block.

badWith.description: Crop pluginIds that should NOT be interplanted (allelopathy, shared disease vectors, etc.).

primaryFamily.description: Anchor crop family for multi-crop systems (e.g., Three Sisters anchors on 'corn'). When present, members[] describes the other families and their planting offsets. Matches a CROP_FAMILIES enum value (see crop.schema.json cropFamily).

members.description: Phase 15 — declarative multi-crop system. Each entry describes a non-anchor member family and its planting offset from the anchor.

benefit.description: One-paragraph explanation of why the system works (nitrogen fixation, weed suppression, pollinator attraction, etc.).
